summary: General Fusion Group Ltd., a British Columbia foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that founder and Chief Science Officer Dr. Michel Laberge signed an employment agreement on October 27, 2026 under which he transitions effective November 1, 2026 to a part-time advisory role as Founder Emeritus through December 31, 2027, terminable on two months' notice or extendable by mutual agreement. Compensation includes base salary and, for calendar year 2026, participation in the cash bonus plan, alongside customary invention assignment, confidentiality, non-solicitation, non-competition and non-disparagement covenants. This is a planned founder transition, not an abrupt forced departure, and carries no transaction terms, advisors or recommendation, so no special-situation or deal-risk angle applies.
